requirement: Every public number references inspected evidence and an exact page/table/cell/record locator
Current observation date is distinct from retrieval, publication and build dates
Missing, stale, provisional, revised and unavailable are visible distinct states
No unsupported 2026 deficit, rank or pressure claim inherited from the conversation
verification: All quarantine Q-IDs adjudicated and release grep

requirement: Fresh retrieval does not reset a stale source observation clock
All deployed normalized records validate against versioned schemas
verification: Full JSON Schema plus cross-record audit

requirement: Data adapter failures preserve last-known-good snapshot and show age
Raw/private/licence-restricted materials are excluded from site and public repo
Source access limitations do not get silently replaced with fabricated values
Rainfall departures use defined normals and ratio-of-sums for aggregation
Precipitation volume is not presented as usable water supply
Population/rainfall ratios are not branded measured scarcity or demand
Historical ranks compare eligible geography, baseline and same seasonal cutoff
verification: Comparison guard and included/excluded year ledger

requirement: Historical frequency k/N is not automatically a return period or probability
Reservoir comparisons use matching monitored cohort, capacity definitions and units
Groundwater level, recharge and extraction assessments are not conflated
Population projections are distinguished from censuses and district estimates
Economic outcomes, exposures and conditional estimates are clearly separated
State/UT navigation comes from a dated official inventory rather than assumed counts
District boundary changes and aliases have explicit crosswalks or exclusions
Maps use permitted, versioned boundaries with honest territorial notes where needed
District-level gaps are not disguised by copied state-level numbers
Map colors match tables; missingness is not normal-condition color
Basin and administrative geography remain distinct and discoverable
Homepage explains scope, latest verified conditions and where to explore
All 16 reporting beats have finished reporting or explicit evidence/gap decisions
Each major story includes context, evidence, uncertainty and links to relevant local data
Improvement, recovery and mixed regional evidence get comparable prominence
Government response distinguishes announcement, allocation, implementation and observed outcomes
No political rankings, endorsements, election forecasts or speculative motives
Voices and quotes retain accurate attribution, event date and original context
No invented interviews, expert endorsements, human reviews or bylines
Wealth/access reporting includes documented buffers and shared-system exposure without stereotypes
Public-information advice is locally applicable, current and safe; contacts are verified
User tips are labeled unverified until investigated; private details never auto-publish
verification: No unsanitized submission path; privacy review

requirement: Official forecasts retain issuer, issue/validity dates, geography, variable and horizon
Expired forecasts are visibly expired and removed from current outlook summaries
Worst plausible scenarios state mechanisms, assumptions, triggers and reversal signals
No countdown, district prediction or composite crisis score without defensible validation
No-change refresh is idempotent and does not rewrite facts as new news
Revised source values invalidate affected calculations, charts and claims
News records distinguish event date and publication date and deduplicate syndication
Corrections retain old and new claim, reason, time and affected release
Routine refresh preserves design/dependencies and emits a reviewable change brief
Scheduled jobs and automatic publication remain disabled without explicit authorization
Real screenshots at 360, 390, 768 and 1440 pixels receive independent review
Narrative and essential facts remain readable with JavaScript disabled
Charts have meaningful title, units, dates, annotations, source, table and export
Keyboard navigation, focus order, contrast and reduced motion are checked
verification: Automated plus manual evidence with limitations

requirement: Mobile interactions do not require hover; maps never trap page scrolling
Long stories have accessible contents, section anchors and return-to-explorer paths
Search finds places, aliases, articles and source/method pages
No fake live dot, disaster imagery or alarming metric hierarchy unsupported by evidence
Every major chart exports data and a source/method/release note
verification: Export content and number parity tests

requirement: Persistent claim and release URLs support sharing and reproducibility
Reuse rights, publisher/AI disclosure, corrections and real contact route are honest
Production works at root and /repository/ prefixes including deep refresh and search
Full and compact static exports have measured file count, sizes and hashes
No runtime API secrets or mandatory paid map/model/backend services
Publication approval is tied to exact release artifact and destination
Release rollback restores a complete last-known-good build with coherent data
External content is treated as untrusted input, not executable instructions
Untrusted pull-request code cannot access publication secrets
Persistent state identifies completed work, blockers and exact next command
Review evidence is tied to source snapshot and artifact hashes, not checkboxes alone
Hand-off distinguishes built, data-verified, editorially-reviewed and deployed
